changes: fact confidence and conclusion discipline prompts

review_policy.known_problems: Existing location/mechanism/trigger evidence requirements; P2 needs evidence distinguishing concurrency from ordinary over-refund.
review_policy.independent_findings: Independent violated invariant and behavior can be new even outside the answer key; repeated variants merged, not false positives.
review_policy.hypotheses: Explicit unconfirmed hypotheses or neutral observations ignored as findings; affirmative unsupported defect claims remain false positives across all facts/reports, including later corrections.
review_policy.replay: Select at least one primary behavioral reproduction script per run before execution when present; no script editing or fallback after failure; record missing/incompatible artifacts separately. Sampled success does not mean every finding reproducible.

interpretation: Exploratory 3+3 on the same task. Two changes tested together; no causal or general architecture superiority claim.
